steps.sql: SELECT m, revenue FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS m, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY 1) s WHERE m >= '2025-05-15' ORDER BY 1

SELECT created_at, revenue FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS created_at, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY 1) s WHERE created_at >= timestamp '2025-05-15 00:00:00' ORDER BY 1
SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS m, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY 1) s WHERE m >= '2025-05-15'
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS m, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) >= '2025-05-15' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
steps.note: the same condition with no subquery
